> **Figure 1.** Five surface protein databases agree on only 188 proteins. UpSet plot of five surface protein databases; each bar counts proteins found in that database or combination and no others, grouped by how many databases list the protein, with total set sizes shown on the left. Bars are shown for the 10 largest combinations plus each database alone. Each set is the protein-coding genes with at least one UniProt accession labeled as a surface protein under the source-specific rule (UniProt: strict surface terms or extracellular topology; GO CC: at least one non-electronic (non-IEA) annotation to a surface-relevant term; HPA: Enhanced/Supported/Approved reliability for Plasma membrane or Cell Junctions; SURFY: published binary classifier output; CSPA: high-confidence or putative; details in Methods).
<!-- END manuscript-legend -->

UpSet over the five source surface-protein databases (UniProt, GO CC, HPA,
SURFY, CSPA). Each bar counts the proteins found in that database *or
combination of databases and no others*; columns are grouped by how many
databases list the protein, running from all five on the left to a single
database on the right. The left panel gives each database's total size
against the five-database average.

Not every combination is drawn. The figure shows the 10 largest
combinations plus each database on its own (11 of the 31 non-empty
combinations, 4,533 of the 5,546 proteins); the other 20 combinations
(1,013 proteins) are left out.

This figure replaces a 5-way Venn. The Venn is not area-proportional and
cannot be made so: all 31 regions are non-empty and span 3–1,063 proteins,
and a least-squares fit of five ellipses to those areas draws the
188-protein five-way core at 305 (+62%) while collapsing the 252-protein
UniProt∩SURFY∩CSPA region to 9. Every bar in an UpSet is a true count.

## Reproduce

```bash
uv run make_db_overlap_upset.py
```

The script declares its own dependencies via PyPA inline script metadata,
so `uv` resolves them; no `pip install` step. It reads
`db_overlap_upset.tsv` (the five database flags, one row per accession)
from the same folder if present, and otherwise from the in-repo copy at
`data/processed/figures/db_overlap_upset.tsv`. It does not download
anything.
